subject: general
question: An item is bought on a condition that three equal instalments of Rs. 3,993 are to be paid at a rate of 10% compound interest, compounded annually. The cost of the item is:
solution:
Given:

The Rate of interest is 10 %

The Installment is Rs. 3993

The number of installments = 3

Formula used:

P( 1+ R/100)ⁿ = X( 1+ R/100)ⁿ⁻¹ + X( 1+ R/100)ⁿ⁻² + X( 1+ R/100)ⁿ ⁻³ + X( 1+ R/100)ⁿ⁻⁴ + ----

Where,

P = principal

R = Rate 

n = number of instalments

X = amount of instalment

Calculation:

P(1 + 10/100)³ = 3993(1+10/100)² + 3993(1 + 10/100)¹ + 3993

⇒ P(1.1)³ = 3993 × 1.21 + 3993 × 1.1 + 3993

⇒ P(1.1)³ = 3993 (1.21 + 1.1 + 1) 

⇒ P(1.1)3 = 3993 (3.31) 

⇒ P = (3993 × 331 × 1000)/(1331 × 100)

⇒ P = 9930

**The cost of the item is** **9930.**
